pieces.Text: Akatas hold hundreds of invisibly small larval young within their mouths, spreading these parasitic creatures to hosts through their bite.  Only humanoids make suitable hosts for akata young - all other creature types are immune to this parasitic infection.  The disease itself is known as void death.  Disease: Void Death: Bite - injury; save Fort DC
; onset 1 hour; frequency 1/day; effect 1d2 Dex and 1d2 Con damage; an infected creature who dies rises as a void zombie 2d4 hours later; cure 2 consecutive saves.
